inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.sub: Your Instagram and TikTok messages and comments in one place.
inbox.needWorker: The inbox needs the Scout Worker running and an Instagram account connected in Settings.
inbox.needPermission: We need Instagram's permission to read your messages and comments and reply to them.
inbox.tokenExpired: The Instagram link expired; connect it again in Settings.
inbox.notAvailable: The old Worker doesn't have the inbox yet; wait for the update.
inbox.tiktok.noDm: TikTok messages aren't available for personal accounts
inbox.tiktok.soon: TikTok comments come once TikTok approves us
inbox.thread.unsupported: A message type we can't show here
inbox.window.closed: Instagram closed the window; the person has to write first
inbox.deleteConfirm: Delete this reply from Instagram? It can't be undone.
inbox.unconfirmed: Sending wasn't confirmed; check the app
inbox.tooLong: The text is longer than the limit
inbox.err.noPermission: We don't have permission to reply; press “Allow messages”.
inbox.err.rateLimited: The platform asked us to slow down; try again in a minute.
inbox.err.upstream: The platform has a problem; try again shortly.
inbox.err.network: Couldn't reach the Worker; check your connection.
inbox.settings.wipeConfirm: Delete all messages and comments stored in the Worker? Your Instagram account isn't affected.
